items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: And Eckstine and I were talking about this -- this band. See, the manager of this band was a guy named Bailey. And Bailey used to manage this band. And he'd book us on jobs

ctx.x: What determined the winner, the audience applause?

Yeah, the audience applause. And they had other winners too but these guys were pretty consistant on winning it. And Eckstine and I were talking about this -- this band. See, the manager of this band was a guy named Bailey. And Bailey was president of the union, the colored union, because the unions were divided back in those days, you know.

And Bailey used to manage this band. And he'd book us on jobs, and man, he'd tell us, oh, we didn't make much money tonight. He'd give us fifty cents apiece, something like that, and maybe he sold the band, 13 pieces, for $150.00. Fifty cents. We talked about that and we laughed, and everytime I see Eckstine that's a standing joke. Bailey's been dead a long time. Did you see Bailey. You know, did you see Bailey. Ah, yeah, Bailey was -- he was something else, man.
